status: Implemented and statically reviewed in both ports; no Java, Gradle, unit/GameTests, client, native execution or audio playback.
scope: Durable once-only ground/aircraft destruction, callback replacement and bounded blocked-crash completion.
confirmedIssues: Ground destroyed and aircraft crashExploded were memory-only; snapshots taken during terminal callbacks could replay explosion/wreck/audio after restoration.
A same-object healthy load during terminal effects could be discarded by the remainder of the old destruction call.
Aircraft movement safety returned before the existing phaseAge>300 completion check, leaving a blocked crash suspended indefinitely.
A mechanically healthy CRASH saved without a delivery home/landing was changed to IDLE by load, although pilot loss is also a valid crash trigger.

sourceComparison.boundary: These original tracks support disabled/collision/final ordering only. The project wreck meshes, Minecraft particles/fire, licensed/project Foley, 120/240/360 cosmetic ticks, radius-three Minecraft physical blast and 300-tick crash timeout are adapters, not recovered original assets or exact original constants.

behavior.groundReceipt: VehicleDestructionCommitted is set with zero HP before the first external destruction effect. Completed loads finish the existing idempotent garage-lost bookkeeping and retire silently on the next server tick; no presentation is replayed.
behavior.aircraftReceipt: CrashExplosionCommitted is set with zero HP before presentation, passenger damage or the physical blast. Pending falls remain uncommitted and resume; completed loads retire silently.
behavior.callbackReplacement: Each readAdditionalSaveData increments a local destruction epoch. All terminal external steps check both commit and epoch afterward. A healthy same-object replacement cannot be discarded or receive a later old explosion. The audio finally-block cannot overwrite replacement controls with old movement.
behavior.migration: Old zero-health records without the new receipt retain the existing one-time completion policy. A new snapshot from that completion records its durable receipt. Historical snapshots taken before commitment are pending events, not evidence that effects already happened.
behavior.movementBoundary: The existing strict phaseAge>300 terminal fallback runs before a refused movement step. A loaded complete seven-block explosion neighborhood permits the existing radius-three physical blast; unavailable/world-height boundaries receive existing authored wreck/particles/Foley without physical terrain queries. Availability is checked again after passenger callbacks. No chunk is forced or generated by the completion guard.
behavior.sixPlacements: Read-only audited VehicleRegistry.ChassisItem maps MILITARY/BLACKWATCH x truck/apc/tank, verifies support/real hull and living-body clearance, and debits the item only after successful addFreshEntity. PrototypeSurvivalLock and both client combat gates already preserve chassis use, including offhand. None of those production placement paths were edited.

ground: all six real lethal entries save the receipt before effects and silently retire a restored completed hull
same-object healthy replacement from a real destruction sound event survives the old call
legacy zero-health without receipt completes once and records it
aircraft: impact sound/physical explosion happens once; completed snapshot retires without replay
healthy replacement from the terminal sound prevents the old physical explosion/discard
blocked boundary crash completes at tick301 while suppressing unavailable physical blast queries
unloaded uncommitted fall resumes without premature impact
deferredValidation.retainedRegression: Existing VehiclePlacementInteractionGameTest, VehicleSupplyGameTest, MilitaryVehicleGameTest and readiness helper are included by the new isolated init.

staticReview.productionMirroring: Only expected defineSynchedData and helicopter lerpTo loader signatures differ.
staticReview.QA: Forge test imports/annotations translated to Forge event bus; source logic identical.

limits: No current build or runtime assertion has been executed; prior historical vehicle-destruction validation is not a result for this change.
Wrecks remain bounded local presentation receipts; late joiners and save reloads do not reconstruct an old lootable wreck.
A physical explosion already handed to Minecraft cannot be rolled back if a callback then replaces the source; the old outer destruction continuation is canceled.
At an unavailable blast neighborhood only presentation and existing direct passenger fall handling complete; no physical area damage is invented.
